messages:
maria_k: Quick sync — need final owners for the 'compliance gateways' milestone. Audit log ingestion + KMS/HSM handoff need clear owners by EOD so we can lock the evidence list for SOC2 fieldwork.

alex: I can take audit log ingestion end-to-end. Plan: backfill + export, then validate checksums. Will need infra help for the S3 ACLs and proof of retention.

ben_s: assign infra piece to @jordan_ops for retention config and log-forwarder cert rotation. I'll own the verification scripts.

jordan_ops: I can do retention config. Timeline: config + test by Thurs. Need the exact bucket names and required ACL/policy bits (read vs read+list).

security_lead: +1 on owners. @maria_k can you paste the evidence schema here? Also @sam will you own the KMS key attestation artifacts and vendor attestation liaison?

sam: I can own KMS attestation. I'll prepare key policy snapshots, HSM vendor attestation checklist, and internal key lifecycle logs. ETA Wed for drafts.

maria_k: Evidence schema (quick snippet). I'll add full page to Confluence after owners confirmed.
```
- audit_log_bucket: s3://redwood-audit
- retention_policy: 365d
- ingest_pipeline: cloudwatch -> kinesis -> lambda -> s3
- backfill_location: s3://redwood-audit/backfill/<run-id>
- checksum_proof: sha256 per file
- kms_policy_snapshots: required (json + signed)
- hsm_attestation: vendor statement + serials
```

alex: For backfill I propose running `./audit-export --range 2023-10-01,2024-03-31 --dest s3://redwood-audit/backfill` — need run window approved and a dry-run first.

jordan_ops: Ops question: who approves the backfill window? compliance or security? Also are we running parallel ingestion suppression to avoid duplicates?

security_lead: I'll approve the window but prefer off-peak (Sun 02:00-06:00 UTC). Agree on suppression during backfill — add a suppression flag to the export.

devops-bot: scheduled maintenance ticket #5678 created: sun-0200-0600-UTC — tagging @eng-oncall.

eng-oncall: noted. We'll be on rotation for the window and can watch the export logs + alert if error rates spike.

ben_s: Quick check: do we need vendor HSM attestation artifacts (signed cert) or is a vendor letter sufficient for auditors?

sam: We need vendor attestation + serials for the modules and an internal key lifecycle trail. I'll coordinate the vendor call on Thurs to get signed artifacts.

maria_k: Action list: 1) Alex — run backfill dry-run, share runplan + checklist by EOD. 2) Jordan — retention config + ACLs by Thurs. 3) Sam — KMS/HSM attestation docs + vendor call prep by Wed. 4) Ben/Infra — confirm export perms and verification scripts. 5) Security_lead — approve final window (done) and add approvals to evidence doc. I'll update Confluence and ping auditors once artifacts are uploaded. :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll post the runplan in this thread later today with the dry-run logs attached.

security_lead: Thanks everyone — keep updates here so auditors can trace changes.
